# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta7

## Stable-cycle deferred vendor trail rendering

This prerelease completes the frontend half of the active-mowing vendor trail starvation fix introduced by Navimower 0.4.5-beta13.

- Treat the retained vendor zone/cycle identity as the authority for whether a deferred current-cycle SVG is still valid.
- Accept a completed older geometry revision when it belongs to the same confirmed zone cycle instead of discarding it just because a newer vendor revision arrived while the request was in flight.
- Keep the accepted same-cycle prefix visible and immediately request the newer geometry in the background.
- Serialize beta7 current-cycle requests so a moving vendor trail cannot create an overlapping request storm.
- Reject late responses from a previous cycle after a confirmed reset/new cycle and clear the old-cycle SVG immediately.
- Keep 0.3.7-beta6 flicker-free DOM updates, sticky vendor ownership, MQTT live-tail behavior, History selection and Multi mower behavior unchanged.

Pair with Navimower 0.4.5-beta13 or newer for the complete backend + frontend starvation fix.
